name: Hebei University
supervisors: Hebei Provincial Government (co-built with the Ministry of Education and SASTIND)

evidence.summary: Hebei University’s 2016–2020 plan says the Hebei government signed an agreement with SASTIND in 2013 to co-build it, which the plan calls a new platform for its defence-specialty disciplines.

Its Hebei key laboratory of optoelectronic information materials says the university won approval in 2017 for a national defence-specialty discipline in military energy technology (军用能源技术) based on the laboratory.
